relations.quote: For AMS/AMS 2 Pro owners, to connect P2S you may need to have a Filament Buffer - P2S (SA011) and Bambu Bus Cable (CAB035).
relations.note: The P2S variant's note names AMS owners connecting a P2S; the spec sheet's "Filament Odometry Supported with AMS" also refers to the AMS. "AMS" resolves to the AMS product as in the reviewed compat targets (kind ams, same_model).

relations.source_title: Bambu Lab US store product page
relations.quote: For AMS/AMS 2 Pro owners, to connect P2S you may need to have a Filament Buffer - P2S (SA011) and Bambu Bus Cable (CAB035).
relations.condition: Only to connect an AMS or AMS 2 Pro to the standalone P2S (the source says "may need"); the Combo has a built-in buffer.
relations.note: SA011 is the frozen SKU code of filament-buffer-p2s in the manifest (variant 652730009259991043). "Note: The standalone P2S (without AMS) does not include a filament buffer."

relations.source_title: Bambu Lab US store product page
relations.quote: For AMS/AMS 2 Pro owners, to connect P2S you may need to have a Filament Buffer - P2S (SA011) and Bambu Bus Cable (CAB035).
relations.condition: Only to connect an AMS or AMS 2 Pro to the standalone P2S ("may need").
relations.note: The same note calls it "a 6pin Bambu Bus Cable (CAB035)". Probably bambu-bus-cable-6pin-for-ams-2-pro-and-ams-ht, but no frozen SKU code links CAB035 to a handle, so the handle is left empty (pending).

relations.source_title: Bambu Lab US store product page
relations.quote: *To connect more than 2 AMS(including AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT), Filament Buffer - P2S (SA011), a 6pin Bambu Bus Cable (CAB035) ,and a 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter (FAZ013-N) is needed.
relations.condition: Only to connect more than 2 AMS units (AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT included), together with the Filament Buffer - P2S and the 6-pin Bambu Bus Cable.
relations.note: Probably bambu-4-in-1-ptfe-adapter, but no frozen SKU code links FAZ013-N to a handle, so the handle is left empty (pending).
